theme_strategy.rationale: The app demands a dual-persona architecture. We use a shared Light theme base to maintain structural unity, but diverge aggressively in execution. The Teacher View uses Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) for a data-dense, Ramp/Stripe-inspired fintech aesthetic. The Student View uses a variation of Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play) infused with Neo-Brutalism (thick borders, high-saturation colors, hard shadows) to feel like a tactile arcade game.
theme_strategy.student_archetype: Archetype 6 (Vibrant Play + Neo-Brutalism) - Game-like, tactile, energetic.

teacher_view.surface_styles: Flat solid surfaces. 1px slate-200 borders. Soft shadow-sm for elevation.

student_view.surface_styles: Neo-brutalist surfaces. White or vibrant backgrounds, 3px solid black borders, hard block shadows.

typography.setup_instructions: Add Google Fonts imports for 'Outfit', 'IBM Plex Sans', and 'Fredoka' to index.css or index.html.

headings.usage: Use for dashboard section titles, metric numbers, and modal headers. text-slate-900.

body.usage: Use for data tables, transaction logs, job descriptions.

headings.usage: Use for massive balance displays (text-5xl to text-6xl), store item names, alert banners.

body.usage: Maintain chunky, playful readability throughout the student experience.

teacher_view.grid_system: MODE B: THE 'CONTROL ROOM' GRID. Tight gaps (gap-4 or gap-6). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. High density.
teacher_view.padding: Standard generous padding (p-6) inside dashboard cards.
teacher_view.alignment: Strict left-alignment for data tables and logs. Center alignment only for empty states.

student_view.grid_system: MODE A: THE 'TETRIS' / 'BENTO' GRID. Generous gaps (gap-6 to gap-8). Mix tall and wide cards to break symmetry.
student_view.padding: Extra generous padding (p-6 to p-8). Keep content breathable.
student_view.alignment: Center alignment for hero balances and CTA blocks. Left alignment for job listings.

buttons.teacher: Shadcn default variant, rounded-md, sleek hover states (hover:bg-slate-800).
buttons.student: Neo-brutalist custom. rounded-xl, border-[3px] border-black, bg-yellow-400, shadow-[4px_4px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]. Active state: translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] shadow-[2px_2px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)].

cards.teacher: Minimalist. bg-white, rounded-xl, border border-slate-200, shadow-sm. No gradient backgrounds.
cards.student: Playful blocks. bg-white or pastel, rounded-2xl, border-[3px] border-black, shadow-[6px_6px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)].

tables_and_lists.teacher: Standard Shadcn tables. Compact padding, hover-row highlights. Sticky headers for long student lists.
tables_and_lists.student: Avoid traditional tables. Use a feed of distinct, chunky list items (cards) stacked vertically with gap-4.

inputs_and_forms.teacher: Shadcn inputs. Focus ring: focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900.
inputs_and_forms.student: Chunky inputs. p-4, text-lg, border-[3px] border-black, rounded-xl.

teacher_view.animations: Subtle and functional. Fade-in for modals, quick slide-up for toast notifications.
teacher_view.hover_states: Color shifts only (e.g., bg-slate-50 to bg-slate-100). No scaling.

student_view.animations: Celebratory. Bouncing entrances for coins, staggered pop-ins for store items.
student_view.microinteractions: Buttons physically press down (translate-y) on click. Earning money should trigger a framer-motion floating +1 effect or similar.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Strict adherence to APCA standards. All text on colored backgrounds must be readable (e.g., black text on yellow/green/blue pastel backgrounds).
accessibility_and_testing.focus_states: MANDATORY clear focus states for keyboard navigation.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='student-pay-all-button', data-testid='job-apply-submit'). Role-based naming, kebab-case.

icons_and_assets.library: lucide-react for Teacher View (clean, thin lines). lucide-react with strokeWidth={3} for Student View to match the chunky aesthetic.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the Dual-Persona layout explicitly: Use separate layout wrappers for '/teacher/*' and '/student/*' routes.
Teacher routes must be strictly professional (Fintech style). Rely on native Shadcn UI defaults with minor tweaks.
Student routes must feel like a game. Override Shadcn styles via className to apply the Neo-Brutalist borders and block shadows.
Ensure 'Pay All' modal and 'End of week salary' buttons are prominently accessible in the Teacher dashboard.
For the student PIN login, use a custom chunky 4-digit keypad interface, not a standard text input.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for any headings.
Apply 'data-testid' to EVERY button, input, and interactive card.
